definitions.gloss: everyday occurrence; commonplace matter; routine event
definitions.explanation: Something so ordinary that it happens all the time and is not worth remarking on. Almost always used in the set phrase {日常茶飯事|にちじょうさはんじ} (everyday occurrence). Literally refers to 'tea and rice matters' — things as routine as having tea and meals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日常茶飯事|にちじょうさはんじ}→日常茶飯事：07288_nichijousahanji⟧だ。
examples.english: Being late is an everyday occurrence.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日常茶飯事|にちじょうさはんじ}→日常茶飯事：07288_nichijousahanji⟧らしい。
examples.english: Apparently, power outages are commonplace in this area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧げんか⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日常茶飯事|にちじょうさはんじ}→日常茶飯事：07288_nichijousahanji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{慣|な}れ→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧っこだった。
examples.english: Sibling fights were an everyday occurrence in childhood, and our parents were used to it.

notes:
Almost exclusively used in the four-character compound ⟦{日常茶飯事|にちじょうさはんじ}→日常茶飯事：07288_nichijousahanji⟧. Using {茶飯事|さはんじ} alone is rare in modern Japanese. The literal meaning is 'tea and rice matters' — things as mundane as daily meals.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{日常茶飯事|にちじょうさはんじ}→日常茶飯事：07288_nichijousahanji⟧だ — to be an everyday occurrence
- ⟦{日常茶飯事|にちじょうさはんじ}→日常茶飯事：07288_nichijousahanji⟧⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧ — as if it were routine
- ⟦{日常茶飯事|にちじょうさはんじ}→日常茶飯事：07288_nichijousahanji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ — to become commonplace

USAGE:
Often used with a negative nuance — the thing described as ⟦{日常茶飯事|にちじょうさはんじ}→日常茶飯事：07288_nichijousahanji⟧ is usually something undesirable (delays, arguments, mistakes) that happens so often it is no longer surprising. Can also be used neutrally to describe something simply routine.

ETYMOLOGY:
{茶|さ} means tea and {飯|はん} means a meal. Together they represent the most basic daily activities, so {茶飯事|さはんじ} means 'a matter as ordinary as having tea and rice.'
